title: fix: styles for Sankey, Gantt, and User Journey diagrams
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Diagrams can now use a custom font-family defined in the Mermaid configuration. If no custom font-family is provided, it defaults to `Trebuchet MS, Verdana, Arial, sans-serif`.

### Key Changes

1. **Gantt Diagrams**
   - Updated styles to use `options.fontFamily` for all text elements.
   - Ensures consistent application of font-family across the diagram.

2. **Sankey Diagrams**
   - Introduced new style definitions using `options.fontFamily`.
   - Removed hardcoded font-family attributes from node labels.

3. **User Journey Diagrams**
   - Adjusted label and text styles to leverage `options.fontFamily` for consistency.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Changes to font-family handling:

- Updated the implementation of styles as the current one was incorrect.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
**nitpick**: The spec recommends to keep font names quoted when we are using whitespace, see https://www.w3.org/TR/2018/REC-css-fonts-3-20180920/#propdef-font-family:

> To avoid mistakes in escaping, it is recommended to quote font family names that contain white space, digits, or punctuation characters other than hyphens:

(Although I think every modern browser handles it fine).

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
**issue(potentially-blocking)**:

This seems to be a breaking change to me (although it's only a minor visual change, so maybe it's not actually breaking?):

Try rendering the following diagram in mermaid.live or on GitHub, and you can see the font is different for the axis labels:

```mermaid
---
config:
    themeVariables:
        fontFamily: 'Impact'
        textColor: 'red'
---
gantt
    title A Gantt Diagram
    dateFormat  YYYY-MM-DD
    section Section
    A task           :a1, 2014-01-01, 1d
```

Your PR seems to allow changing the other vars, but not this one!

It looks like 50% of the CSS in Mermaid is using `var(--mermaid-font-family)` (aka `MermaidConfig["fontFamily"]`, but the other half seems to be using `options.fontFamily` (aka `MermaidConfig["themeVariables"]["fontFamily"]` and https://mermaid.js.org/config/theming.html#theme-variables
